verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI explicitly advertises natural-language debugging/troubleshooting (gemini-cli-gh-3, gh-12/21/23) and community reports confirm strong codebase navigation and code-review value (gemini-cli-comm-1, comm-20). However, multiple hands-on reports directly contradict reliable debugging: users describe it getting stuck in error loops, failing simple file edits, and in one case catastrophically deleting user data during a troubleshooting session (gemini-cli-comm-10, comm-11, comm-14, comm-16).
